name: ig-design-system
description: Infragistics design system: design tokens generated with igniteui-theming, plus the checks that keep sites consistent.
author: Infragistics, Inc.

scripts.build: node src/make.ts && node src/migration.ts docs/MIGRATION.md && node src/namespace.ts && node src/dtcg.ts dist/tokens.json dist/theme.css dist/infragistics.tokens.json && node src/showcase.ts dist/tokens.json docs/showcase.html && node src/guide.ts dist/tokens.json package.json docs/index.html && tsc -p tsconfig.cli.json && node src/llms.ts dist/tokens.json package.json llms.txt llms-full.txt dist/tokens.css dist/theme.css
scripts.check: node checks/lint.ts reference/components && node checks/check-vars.ts dist/tokens.css dist/theme.css dist/base.css docs/showcase.html docs/index.html reference && node checks/spacing-roles.ts reference && node checks/gates-derived.ts && node checks/gates-themes.ts && node checks/resolve.ts && node dist/cli/checks/cli.js check reference/components.css && node dist/cli/checks/cli.js check docs/examples
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run check
